name: Blank Embrace (Darkroom)
tagline: Artist storefront for Blank Embrace, hosted on Darkroom's print-on-demand gallery platform
description: The portfolio and print storefront of Blank Embrace, a digital mixed media artist who combines digital and analog technique with AI image tools. It runs on Darkroom, a hosted platform that gives artists a gallery subdomain and handles printing and delivery of sold work. The site itself is a minimal image-first gallery with an about blurb and links to Instagram and X; no collection names, work counts, or prices were exposed to a text fetch.
agent_guidance: Reach for this as visual reference for AI-assisted mixed-media art direction, or as a worked example of the Darkroom pattern when a user asks for an artist site that also sells prints — Darkroom removes the fulfilment problem that otherwise sinks a custom build. Do not try to scrape the works: the page is an image grid with no titles, prices, or structured metadata in the HTML, so anything you assert about the catalog will be invented. Pair it with the artist's X profile for context on new work.
why_it_matters: A concrete example of a working artist shipping AI-inflected mixed media through a hosted print storefront rather than a bespoke site.
notable_for: digital plus analog plus AI technique
exhibited in Rome, Milan, Bangkok, New York, Lisbon

name: Blank Embrace on X
tagline: X feed of digital mixed media artist Blank Embrace, posting new work and process
description: The X (Twitter) account of Blank Embrace, a digital mixed media artist whose stated aim is to give visual form to feelings. The feed is where new pieces and process snippets surface first, ahead of the curated Darkroom storefront. Content is images with short captions rather than written craft material.
agent_guidance: Use this as a live feed for the artist's newest output when the Darkroom storefront looks stale; the storefront is curated and lags the feed. X blocks plain HTTP fetches, so route any read through an X-aware tool or an authenticated API rather than WebFetch, and expect image-only payloads with no alt text worth mining. Cite the Darkroom site, not this handle, when you need a stable link.
why_it_matters: The primary release channel for an artist working at the seam of analog technique and AI image tools, useful as a running mood reference.
evidence: Not fetched by instruction (x.com); record built from the supplied title, description, and tags, cross-checked against the artist bio confirmed on https://blankembrace.darkroom.com.
